description: This file defines a Java interface for reading business date information within the Fineract project. It specifies methods to retrieve all business dates, a business date by type, and a map of business dates by type.

classes.name: BusinessDateReadPlatformService
classes.description: A service interface providing methods to access business date data such as all dates, dates by type, and a map of dates.

methods.name: findByType
methods.description: Retrieves a BusinessDateDTO for a given date type specification.

methods.name: getBusinessDates
methods.description: Returns a HashMap linking BusinessDateType to corresponding LocalDate objects.
